a: The stylesheet adds a shape's insets to the `padding` prop, where the prop's doc, `ownPadding` and docs/unruled.md (2026-11-20) say the prop replaces them
On a fitted base (Quatrefoil, Puzzle, OctantSpline, OctantBSpline) with a `padding` prop, the inset fit can flip between two values forever
A `padding` of one `var()` (or a non-shorthand) skips the insets entirely, yet `ownPadding` still subtracts the inset, so the fit under-reads the badge's padding
A removable button-label's keyboard activation bypasses `labelProps.onClick` and its `preventDefault` veto
b: The padding prop both adds to and replaces the shape's insets: CSS adds them, `ownPadding` and the prop's doc assume replacement, so a fitted base double-counts the inset
Keyboard activation of a split label skips `labelProps.onClick`, which a mouse click runs and can veto
A lone-`var()` padding (prop or `style.padding`) silently drops any per-side padding given alongside it
An out-of-registry `base` prop discards the shape's own composition and draws nothing
Catalog lookups throw on a name outside the registry, where every other lookup in the area tolerates one
